headline: Fronts Flare Across Six Sectors as Bases Shift
war_summary: Day 185 of War 140 shows the map still divided between entrenched Warden holdings in the north‑west and Colonial control across the southern belt, but the last three hours have sharpened fighting on a handful of fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest sector, logging 58 ownership changes in the past 24 hours and four in the last two, with Warden casualties accelerating to 130 per hour. Stlican Shelf follows closely with 37 daily flips and eight fresh changes in the past two hours, both sides seeing accelerating loss rates. Linn Mercy recorded 27 daily transitions and three new flips, while casualties and enlistments surge for both factions. Stonecradle added 27 daily flips and two recent changes, with casualties climbing sharply. Fisherman’s Row saw 14 daily flips and two new events, casualties steady. Viper Pit produced seven daily flips and five in the last two hours, casualties high but beginning to cool, while enlistments rise rapidly. Godcrofts and Deadlands still show elevated 24‑hour activity but no fresh two‑hour moves, and Callahan’s Passage remains quiet despite massive casualty traffic. Enlistments are climbing on the most volatile fronts, signalling continued pressure on strategic bases.
